name: SikaRapid C-100
paste:
SIKARAPID® C-100: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRapid® C-100, April 2023, Version 02.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikarapid_c-100.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRapid® C-100 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.03).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaRapid® C-100 is a liquid hardening accelerator for concrete and mortar.
    - SikaRapid® C-100 promotes early strength development while positively influencing final strengths.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaRapid® C-100 is especially suitable for any application where fast early strength development plays a major role, or is of crucial importance within the first hours. SikaRapid® C-100 is used for the following applications:
    - Precast concrete
    - Ready- mixed concrete where early demoulding is essential
    - Slip-formed concrete
    - Ready- mixed concrete where minimum time delays are critical
    - Concrete mixes containing blended cements
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRapid® C-100
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Hardening accelerator
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. SikaRapid® C-100 provides the following advantages through accelerated hardening of the concrete within 4 to 18 hours depending on concrete mix design, fresh concrete temperature and curing conditions:
    - Faster turnaround of formwork in precast applications
    - Reduced or eliminated heat or steam curing
    - Fast construction processes and early load bearing capacity
    - No negative effects on the final strengths
    - Ensured early strength development of concrete mixes produced with blended cements
    - Utilization of optimized binder paste volume leading to increased durability
    SikaRapid® C-100 does not contain chlorides or any other ingredients which promote the corrosion of steel. It is therefore suitable for use in reinforced concrete structures.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Clear liquid
    - Density: ~1,40 kg/l (at +23 °C).
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Conventional dry material content: 54 % approximately
    - Total chloride ion content: < 0,01 M.-% (chloride-free)
2.6 Concreting guidance. The standard rules of good concreting practice, concerning production as well as placing, are to be followed. Laboratory trials shall be carried out before concreting on site, especially when using a new mix design or producing new concrete components. Fresh concrete must be cured properly and curing applied as early as possible, especially at low temperatures.
2.7 Specific advice. If frozen and/or if precipitation of the product has occurred, SikaRapid® C- 100 may be used after thawing slowly at room temperature and intensive mixing. Before application, suitability tests must be performed.
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC; 10 Litre drum
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production if stored properly in undamaged unopened, original sealed packaging
    - Storage conditions: Storage temperatures between +5°C and +35°C. Protect from direct sunlight, frost and contamination.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: 500–2000 ml/100 kg of cementitious (according to the target accelerating effect).
4.3 Dispensing. SikaRapid® C-100 is added to the gauging water or added with it into the concrete mixer. SikaRapid® C-100 may also be added into the ready- mix truck on site. When added on site the truck mixer shall rotate its drums at maximum revolutions for at least 1 minute per m³ concrete and a minimum of 5 minutes to achieve a uniform mix. The concrete has to be visually checked for uniform consistence before discharging.
4.4 Compatibility. SikaRapid® C-100 may be combined with many other Sika products. Do not use SikaRapid® C-100 in conjunction with expansion generating or shrinkage compensating admixtures. Important: Always conduct trials before combining products in specific mixes and contact Sika technical service for information and advice about any specific combinations.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - When using SikaRapid® C-100 a suitable mix design has to be produced and the local material sources shall always be trialled.
    - It is advised against the application of SikaRapid® C- 100 in pre-tensioned prestressed concrete produced with the span bed method.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRapid® C-100, April 2023, Version 02.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikarapid_c-100.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaRapid® C-100, version 14/09/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/SikaRapid%20C-100.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaRapid® C-100, version 17/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sds-sikarapid-c-100.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions.
    - Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product
    - Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
